name: dscope-la-osc
description: Drive DSLogic Plus logic analyzer and DSCope U3P100 oscilloscope for hardware signal capture and measurement: Vpp, frequency, duty cycle, amplitude, noise, edge rate, DSHOT/PWM/UART/I2C/SPI/CAN decoding, and automated assertion reports for HIL testing.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 驱动 DSLogic Plus 逻辑分析仪和 DSCope U3P100 示波器做硬件信号采集与测量：Vpp/峰峰值、频率、占空比、幅值、噪声、沿速、DSHOT/PWM/UART/I2C/SPI/CAN 协议解码，以及 HIL 测试自动断言报告。
